hero.intro: Valves for subsea production systems: manifolds, pipeline end manifolds and terminations, subsea trees and pipelines. They are designed for long service where they cannot be reached, with metal-to-metal seals, stem seals that hold against external sea pressure as well as line pressure, and ROV-operable interfaces.

guidance.heading: Gate or ball, and how it is operated
guidance.body: Slab gate valves to API 17D are the usual choice on subsea trees and manifolds, where a compact, metal-sealed, bidirectional valve with a linear actuator suits the hydraulic control system. Ball valves to API 6DSS cover larger bores on pipelines and PLEM/PLET isolation. Both can be manual for diver or ROV operation, gearbox-operated, or hydraulically actuated with an ROV override.

products.descriptionLong:

API 6A sets the design, materials and testing of wellhead and christmas-tree equipment. Each piece is specified by its rated working pressure (2,000 to 20,000 psi), temperature class, material class (AA to HH, with DD to HH for sour service to NACE MR0175 / ISO 15156), product specification level (PSL 1 to 4) and performance requirement (PR1 or PR2).

Construction

  • Non-rising stem with backseat; lip-seal or pressure-energised stem packing
  • Bearing housing with grease fitting, bonnet lubricator for emergency stem sealing
  • Flanged, studded, threaded or hammer-union ends; manual, gear or actuated
